strict_W50_eligibility.interpretation: The frozen W=50 specification cannot yet receive canonical HEPS prospective or walk-forward evidence on the active-era ledger.

sgce_raw_pair_persistence_diagnostic.interpretation: No detected persistence edge in raw historical pair co-occurrence; this does not test a valid strict-W50 spectral model.

supplied_python_row_norm_exploratory_rep.interpretation: The code-as-written does not show detected acquisition lift and does not implement the written k-means/centroid model.

written_kmeans_variant_exploratory_repla.interpretation: Results are seed-sensitive because k-means initialization is not frozen; observed hit counts are compatible with matched random exposure.

adaptive_k_exact_null_exposure.interpretation: Raw recall improvement from K expansion has a large exact-null exposure component and cannot be credited as predictive lift.

macro_sum_volatility_diagnostics.interpretation: Exploratory only; no detected basis for macro-sum-volatility-controlled K expansion at the present sample.

line_filter_geometry.interpretation: The filters compress line space substantially but no winner-retention lift is detected. Applying them now would also delete 11 of 20 already-frozen Friday lines and is therefore prohibited.

gap_null_filtering.reason: NULL_GAP_DM is uniform over all legal six-gap compositions and therefore cannot rank or reject one legal line as less structurally null-probable than another. The max-gap<=25 rule is a separate morphology constraint, not a NULL_GAP_DM implication.

in_wheel_pruning.reason: Moving an unchanged filter earlier can reduce compute but does not create predictive information. The newly supplied filters are reproducible enough for future benchmarking but have not demonstrated prospective winner-retention lift.

overall_conclusion: No detected predictive edge sufficient for HEPS architecture promotion. Retain as experimental challenger; do not alter the frozen 2026-08-28 Main slate.
